Base: cms/phase-1 AFTER both P5-FIX2 and P5-DRILLS have merged (check git log for both merge commits; if either is missing, stop and report). Add one all-or-none writer to lib/documents/service.js: createFirstRunDocuments({ docs: [{ type, id, body }], actor, allowEmptyRefill = true }). The actor must be { kind:'system', id:'first-run' }; refuse any other actor with DocumentError(400, 'FIRST_RUN_ACTOR') (developer guard; plain words anyway).
1. Read the current rows for the ids (columns per service.js ~l.183: draft_hash, revision, published_version_id, archived_at, updated_by).
2. Compute EMPTY_HASH(type) = documentHash(prepare(type, emptyBody(type)).body). documentHash strips ids, so the random section ids newSection() mints do not matter (never deep-equal bodies).
3. Classify each document:
   - absent: insert;
   - generator-owned: updated_by 'system:first-run' AND published_version_id IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL: refill at its revision;
   - untouched empty (only when allowEmptyRefill): revision 1 AND published_version_id IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND draft_hash = EMPTY_HASH(type): refill at revision 1;
   - anything else: skipped, reason 'founder' | 'published' | 'archived'.
   - A refill whose prepared hash equals the current draft_hash is reported as unchanged and NOT written (no revision bump, no version row).
4. Validate every body to be written in draft mode through the same prepare path createDocument uses (sanitize, versions, refs).
5. ONE libsql batch: documentsGuardStatement(); a not-live guard that aborts when release_state.live_release_id IS NOT NULL (this guard, not the published_version_id column, is what makes a refill safe after a take-offline set published_version_id back to NULL, service.js ~l.960); per written document an INSERT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS, or an UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND revision=? AND <the classified predicate, repeated in SQL: the updated_by/published_version_id IS NULL/archived_at IS NULL test, or revision = 1 AND published_version_id IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND draft_hash = ?>, each followed by the ABORT pattern; the version rows and document_refs rows as createDocument writes them; pruneStatement(id) per refilled document as saveDraft does.
6. Map aborts with classifyAbort exactly as openEntityContent does (service.js ~l.873): mode legacy -> 409 STORE_USES_LEGACY, migrating -> 409 STORE_MIGRATING (MIGRATING_MESSAGE); live store -> 409 FIRST_RUN_STORE_LIVE; lost race -> 409 FIRST_RUN_RACE, nothing written. Do not add DOCUMENTS_MODE_REQUIRED.
7. Return { written, created, refilled, unchanged, skipped: [{ id, reason }] }. Never touch a skipped document; no document_versions row for it.
8. API shapes: you own the phase 6 step. In scripts/test-api-shapes.js accept since 'p6' (~l.201) and add FIRST_RUN_ACTOR, FIRST_RUN_STORE_LIVE and FIRST_RUN_RACE to NEW_CODES; in lib/admin/documents-api-shapes.js add their outcomes with since 'p6' (test-api-shapes ~l.107-117/280-293 scans every lib/documents/*.js for DocumentError codes and fails on a code with no outcome). P6-OPEN adds its codes to the same p6 set in batch 2. Add the rows to scripts/test-failure-matrix.js if it enumerates service codes.
9. lib/documents/policy-pages.js (revision 4: moved here from P6-OPEN, because P6-OPEN, P6-POLICY-START (both batch 2) and P6-ONBOARD (batch 4) all import it, so it must exist before batch 2). One shared policy rule, no DocumentError codes:
   - isPrivacySlug(slug) = /privacy/ and isReturnsSlug(slug) = /terms|refund|return/ (the rule lib/admin/onboarding.js ~l.136 and lib/releases.js ~l.265 use today); POLICY_KINDS = ['privacy','returns']; kindOfSlug(slug) -> 'privacy' | 'returns' | null (privacy wins when both match).
   - POLICY_STARTER_ACTOR = Object.freeze({ kind:'system', id:'policy-starter' }) and POLICY_STARTER_BY = 'system:policy-starter' (actorString of it). A page whose updated_by is POLICY_STARTER_BY is a starter draft waiting for the founder's review; that column is the review mark (no schema change).
   - policyStatus(rows, setIds = []) (pure): rows are page documents { id, type, slug, label, revision, draftHash, publishedVersionId, archivedAt, updatedBy }; only type 'page', not archived, with a slug count. For each kind it returns { state, doc } where state is the best of, in this order: 'live' (publishedVersionId set), 'inSet' (id in setIds, any author: publishing a page in the set is the founder's own choice), 'saved' (a draft whose last writer is NOT POLICY_STARTER_BY: the founder saved it, pressed "I've read it", or it is the founder's own text brought over by the cutover, 'system:cutover'), 'starter' (a draft by POLICY_STARTER_BY), else 'missing' with doc null. Ties go to the most recently updated document. THE REVIEW RULE (owner answer OQ-P6-2/3, revision 4): live, inSet and saved count; a starter draft never counts unless it is in the set.
   - readPolicyRows() (Node): one SELECT id, type, slug, label, revision, draft_hash, published_version_id, archived_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM documents WHERE type = 'page' AND archived_at IS NULL AND slug IS NOT NULL, mapped to the row shape above. listDocuments is NOT changed (it does not return updated_by and its output is pinned elsewhere).
   Test it in scripts/test-documents.js.
Do not change createDocument, saveDraft or their behaviour. Write docs/cms-reviews/P6-GEN-WRITE.md.
acceptance: Unit (test-documents): on a fresh documents store it creates doc_home and doc_design in one batch, with version rows by 'system:first-run' (plainName 'Storeasy').

Unit: a second call with different bodies refills both (revision +1, old versions pruned as saveDraft prunes); a third call with the same bodies reports both unchanged with no revision bump and no new version row.
Unit: a founder-saved doc_home (merchant updated_by) is skipped with reason 'founder'; revision, body and version count unchanged.

Unit: a doc_home created by createDocument with emptyBody('home') under a merchant actor (revision 1, random section ids) is refilled; the same document with one section added is skipped; with allowEmptyRefill:false the empty one is skipped too.
Unit: a published document is skipped; a live store gets 409 FIRST_RUN_STORE_LIVE; a legacy store 409 STORE_USES_LEGACY and a migrating store 409 STORE_MIGRATING, nothing written.

Unit: a revision race (a founder save between classify and batch, via a test hook) aborts the whole batch, neither document changes, error FIRST_RUN_RACE; the empty-hash race (founder edits a revision-1 empty doc between classify and batch) also aborts.

Unit (test-documents, policy-pages): isReturnsSlug matches 'terms', 'refund-policy' and 'returns' and not 'about'; kindOfSlug('privacy-terms') is 'privacy'. policyStatus: a published privacy page is 'live'; a starter draft (createDocument with POLICY_STARTER_ACTOR) is 'starter', and 'inSet' when its id is in setIds; the same page after a merchant saveDraft is 'saved'; a 'system:cutover' draft is 'saved'; an archived page and a page with no slug are ignored ('missing'); readPolicyRows returns updatedBy for each page.
Unit: test-api-shapes passes with the p6 since value and the three codes; the writer scan in test-documents still passes; createDocument and saveDraft outputs unchanged; pnpm test passes.

items.brief:
Base: cms/phase-1 AFTER both P5-FIX2 and P5-DRILLS have merged (check git log for both merge commits; if either is missing, stop and report). Build the deterministic generator and its triggers. Never import lib/ai.
1. lib/first-run/plan.js (pure, edge-safe): planFirstStore({ siteName, catalog: { products: [{ id, title, available, featured_image, featured_image_alt, created_at }], collections: [{ id, handle, title, available, total }] }, paletteId }) returns { home, design, summary }.
   Hero: title = siteName cut to 60 at a word boundary; highlight '' and badge ''. Subtitle from a fixed neutral template list filled only with catalog facts (e.g. top collection titles), else DEFAULT_HERO_SUBTITLE; on an EMPTY catalog use an empty subtitle if the hero kind allows it, else DEFAULT_HERO_SUBTITLE; NEVER EMPTY_STORE_HERO_SUBTITLE ('opening soon' would be wrong once the store opens). Primary CTA: /collections when at least one collection has available products; '#new' when there are products but no usable collection, ONLY if '#new' passes the cta/link kind validation in publish mode (check it), else no CTA; none on an empty catalog. No secondary CTA. Image: featured_image of the first available product (top collection first) that is https and 500 characters or fewer, alt = featured_image_alt || product title (cut to fit); else null.
   Sections: a collections section when 2+ collections have available products; up to 2 product_rail sections on collections with known available > 0 only. If you use pickRailCollection (lib/registry/starter.js ~l.42), pre-filter to available > 0 and map field names (available -> available_count, total -> product_count): its later fallbacks pick unknown or sold-out collections. Rail titles = collection title cut to 50. A 'new' section when products exist. All sold out: hero plus 'new' only, no COLLECTION_EMPTY. Empty catalog: hero only, valid, not HOME_EMPTY.
   Design: designBodyFor(paletteId || DEFAULT_PALETTE_ID). Never KITS presets, an announcement, reviews or a badge. Header and footer documents are NOT generated (null = auto mode: menus derived from the catalog at render).
   summary: { heroImage: { productTitle } | null, collections: [titles used], rails: [titles], paletteId } for the start page's 'what was made' copy.
2. lib/first-run/generate.js (Node): generateFirstStore({ trigger: 'sync'|'console'|'editor', actor }).
   - Permission: for 'console' and 'editor' the actor must pass canEdit (lib/admin/entity-entry.js) / storefront.write, as documents-api WRITES require (documents-api.js ~l.105); otherwise { ran:false, reason:'read_only' } with no write. 'sync' runs as the worker (no actor).
   - Eligibility: documents mode, no live release, confirmedCatalogSync().confirmed, AND doc_home is absent, generator-owned, or untouched-empty (same predicates as the writer). If doc_home was written by a founder, return { ran:false, reason:'founder_started' } and write NOTHING (not even doc_design): existing closed tenants who already built a home page are left alone.
   - Reads the catalog through repo/db reads, plans, calls createFirstRunDocuments with actor system:first-run and allowEmptyRefill = (trigger !== 'sync') (a sync-time refill never overwrites an empty doc a founder's editor just created). On FIRST_RUN_RACE retry once.
   - Returns the writer result plus { products, collections, runId, summary }.
   - describeFirstStore(): { eligible, reason, generated: Boolean(doc_home exists), byGenerator: [ids still generator-owned], kept: [ids skipped as founder], empty: products === 0, noCollections, summary (re-derived from the current generator-owned drafts) }.
3. Triggers:
   - lib/platform/worker.js catalog_sync (~l.134-157, time-boxed by SLICE_MS): when res.done and status 'complete', and at least 5 s of the slice deadline remain, await generateFirstStore({ trigger:'sync' }) in a try/catch that only logs; otherwise skip and log first_run_deferred. The job result is unchanged apart from a firstRun summary field. Not hooked (state in P6-GEN-01.md and the owner end-to-end check): inline console slices (lib/sync-jobs inline path), CLI runCatalogSync and the connect callback's after(); those stores generate when the founder opens /admin/start or the editor.
   - New app/api/admin/first-run/route.js (nodejs): GET returns describeFirstStore() plus catalogSyncProgress (lib/platform/sync-jobs.js; storefront.read); POST runs generateFirstStore({ trigger:'console', actor }) (storefront.write; read-only actors get 403 with plain words).
   - app/(console)/admin/(authed)/editor/page.js (P5-FIX2 just changed it; rebase on it): when the actor canEdit, the store is documents, closed and eligible, and doc_home is absent, call generateFirstStore({ trigger:'editor', actor }) before rendering, so the editor never creates empty singletons first. This is a write during a server render: it is idempotent and must catch and log errors (never fail the page). Read-only actors never trigger it. Decide from the page's OWN listDocuments result and mode read (test-editor-routes pins modeReads === 1 and docsReads === 1 per render, ~l.304), and load the generator with a dynamic import (await import("@/lib/first-run/generate")) only on that branch, so the suites that compile and render this page with stubbed modules (test-editor-routes, test-product-editor, test-provision) never load the generator chain and pass unchanged. After a run that wrote documents, read listDocuments once more on that branch only.
   Console conventions that existing suites check by walking the source tree: (a) test-failure-matrix.js (~l.1039): every `} catch (e) {` in an app/api/admin route answers its own refusals first, then calls infraResponse(e), then falls back; (b) test-console-fresh.js (~l.571): routes resolve the store through tenantHandler(...); (c) test-console-fresh.js (~l.547): console pages import tfetch from "@/lib/console-request"; (d) test-legacy-routes.js (~l.496): new files must not contain literal links to /admin/catalog, /admin/home, /admin/upsells or /admin/storefront. 
Legacy and migrating tenants: every entry point returns ran:false with no write. Fixtures: use P6-FIXTURE's documents + sync options; delete process.env.CHECKOUT_MODE; keep checkout 'direct' with no maintenance or billing snapshot, so test-first-run stays green after P6-OPEN's always-on payment check merges.
Write docs/cms-reviews/P6-GEN-01.md (design notes, the un-hooked sync paths, known limits incl. the sync-time refill bumping the revision of an open generator-owned draft, owner checks).

After batch 0 review (read the From review list in the named packets):
- (P6-GEN-WRITE) When nothing needs writing the writer answers written:false with no batch, even on a live, legacy or migrating store. Check eligibility yourself before calling it and never report written:false as 'generated'. Add tests in scripts/test-documents.js (yours this batch): document_refs rows for a body containing /api/media/<id> on both create and refill (mutations M1/M1b); a founder-edited doc_home returned to the empty body (revision above 1) is skipped as 'founder' (M6).
- (P6-FIXTURE) scripts/support/banned-copy.js (yours this batch): the '#1' claim rule matches hex colours ('#1a2b3c') and 'stars' flags product names. Tighten '#1' to not match hex, scan only text props of generated documents (never tokens or ids), and never scan the founder's own catalog words (product titles) for claims. scripts/test-schema-compat.js (yours this batch): remove .test-compat-p6-bad-tenant.db before the refusal test so a crashed run heals itself; add a test that plants a cms_blocks row first and expects documents mode to be refused (pins applyContentMode).
acceptance: Unit (test-first-run): for each fixture shape (one, few, many, all_sold_out, no_images, long_titles, no_collections, empty) the generated doc_home and doc_design validate in publish mode with 0 errors (validateDocument plus referenceChecks); no COLLECTION_EMPTY; hero title <= 60 characters; no rail binds a collection with 0 available.

Unit: after that publish the rendered header lists the catalog's collections (auto mode) and the footer renders; once an empty header singleton is created through createDocument (emptyBody mode 'auto') the catalog menu is unchanged; no_collections publishes valid with its CTA.

Unit: banned-copy scanText over every generated text string returns no BANNED or CLAIMS hit; every text value is a fixed template, siteName, or a catalog title or alt (provenance test); the empty-catalog hero has no 'opening soon' text.
